title: GDG DevFest Warsaw 2026
description: GDG DevFest Warsaw 2026: Real Work, Real Lessons. A community-run tech conference on November 21, 2026 at Google for Startups Campus Warsaw.
keywords: GDG, DevFest, Warsaw, developers, technology, community, conference

cfpBlock.title: Real Work, Real Lessons.
cfpBlock.description: Got something real to share? We’re not looking for a corporate pitch, a reheated slide deck, or a generic “AI is changing everything” talk. Bring the project that taught you a hard lesson, the experiment that surprised you, the debugging story that changed your approach, or the side project you cannot stop thinking about. First-time and experienced speakers welcome!
cfpBlock.openTo: All experience levels — first-time & veteran speakers welcome
cfpBlock.platform: Auditorium (~200 ppl), Cafe (~50 ppl) & Classroom (~40 ppl) stages
cfpBlock.cta: Submit a Talk or Workshop on Advocu
cfpBlock.note: AI is welcome — AI-for-the-sake-of-AI is not. Concrete lessons and practical builds beat buzzwords.

pastDevFestsBlock.title: Built together over the years.
pastDevFestsBlock.description: DevFest Warsaw is a community tradition built by organizers, speakers, partners, and attendees. Explore selected editions that brought our community together before 2026.

visitBlock.title: Plan your visit.
visitBlock.intro: Registration opens at 09:00 at Google for Startups Campus Warsaw, Plac Konesera 10.
visitBlock.metro: Take Metro M2 to Dworzec Wileński — Koneser is a short walk away.
visitBlock.surface: Buses and trams also serve the Dworzec Wileński and Ząbkowska area.
visitBlock.parking: On Saturday, street parking in Warsaw’s paid zone is free, subject to space and signed local restrictions. Koneser also has a 24-hour paid underground car park.
visitBlock.accessibility: The entire venue is wheelchair accessible, with step-free seating available. The Koneser complex also has ramps and lifts.
visitBlock.wifi: Wi-Fi will be available for attendees.
visitBlock.cloakroom: An open, self-service cloakroom will be available. It is not staffed or monitored, so please keep valuables with you.
visitBlock.accessibilityHelp: Need an accessibility adjustment? Contact the organizers.

scheduleBlock.title: Schedule
scheduleBlock.intro: A single jam-packed day across three stages: Auditorium (~200 ppl), Cafe (~50 ppl), and Classroom (~40 ppl).
scheduleBlock.note: 15-minute fire talks, 30-minute standard sessions, and up to 1-hour interactive workshops.
scheduleBlock.emptyState: Call for Papers is live! We’re reviewing submissions across practical AI/ML, Cloud, Web, Mobile, Firebase, Open Source, and engineering culture. Full timetable coming soon.
